newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-HEERENVEEN END PSV'S UNDEFEATED HOME RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HEERENVEEN END PSV'S UNDEFEATED HOME RECORD.

text.p: Dutch first division leaders PSV Eindhoven suffered their first home defeat of the season when they lost 1-0 to Heerenveen on Saturday.
And for PSV's Wim Jonk the match was a minor fiasco.
After missing a penalty in the 69th minute, the Dutch international was sent off 11 minutes later when his dive in Heerenveen's penalty area was rewarded with his second yellow card.

Jon Dahl Tomasson, the league's leading scorer and on the shopping list of Ajax Amsterdam, settled the match with his 17th goal of the season when he converted a Geofrey Talan cross five minutes before halftime.
Heerenveen outclassed the Eindhoven side, still suffering their customary dip after the winter break, with attacking one-touch soccer and had several good opportunities to extend their lead.
PSV, who had won 11 and drawn one of their previous 12 home fixtures, stay on 58 points from 26 matches. Second-placed Feyenoord could draw level on points if they beat lowly AZ Alkmaar on Sunday.
